caption: The drawing features a metal trivet depicted in three different views on a beige background. At the top, there is a plan (top-down) view, showing the trivet’s shield-like shape with rounded edges and decorative cutouts, including a central pattern resembling interlocking geometric forms, flanked by stylized scroll and floral motifs along the border. Beneath this plan view, there is a straight-on side view that illustrates the trivet standing on three short legs, with a small scale for reference beside it, marked in inches. The largest image at the bottom displays the trivet in perspective, further emphasizing its three-dimensional nature and the depth of the decorative cutouts. The trivet appears to be cast metal, rendered with shading in pencil or graphite, and is monochromatic in gray tones. The name "Gordon Sanborn" appears in small letters in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Flat Iron Holder
